## The claim

P4-4a: a cold MVP run — four lanes over the ~39,300 allele records — completes in at most one hour of laptop wall-clock at zero dollars.

**Prediction if true.** Scoring all four enabled lanes from an empty cache takes <= 3,600 s of wall-clock on this laptop, spends nothing, and every lane writes exactly one warehouse.data_lineage edge named it4-score:<model>.

**What would refute it.** The cold four-lane pass takes more than 4 hours — then the join is profiled and the fix recorded.

| Rev | Status | Confidence | Reasoning |

| 2 | testing | 0.15 | Undecided by its own terms, and recorded as such rather than rounded either way. The cold four-lane pass measured 6,320 s at zero dollars: 1.76x the 3,600 s the claim predicted, and 0.44x the 4 h that was pre-registered as refuting, so neither clause fires. Confidence 0.15 because the number is 76 % over the prediction and the run shows no sign of being unlucky. The refutation clause asks which lane is responsible and it is answered: not a join — the three local lanes finish 47,697 alleles in 53 s — but one serial remote lane, REVEL, at 6,267 s over four attempts against an endpoint that failed three times. Two fixes already took it from about 4.6 h to 1 h 45 m; the third, parallelism (iteration 2 runs three workers on the same service), would put the pass near 35 minutes. That is the revision this claim is owed. Entry 122. |
